# Machine Learning Certification Hub

> Open-source study hub created by Michaël Bettan for mastering AI/ML engineering and acing Google Cloud and Anthropic Claude certifications. Provides interactive HTML study guides, architecture diagrams, comparison tables, and self-assessment drills.

## Overview

- **Site URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/
- **Author**: Michaël Bettan (https://www.linkedin.com/in/mbettan/ · https://github.com/mbettan)
- **License**: Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/mbettan/machine-learning-cert/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Interactive Study Guides (HTML)

- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/RAG.html): Context strategies (RAG vs. Long Context vs. Fine-Tuning vs. Prompt Caching vs. Live Tools), chunking, dense/sparse/hybrid retrieval (`BM25` + `HNSW`/`ScaNN`), Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`RRF`), cross-encoder reranking, untrusted context & refusal gates, Agentic RAG & memory, GraphRAG, Google Cloud RAG (Vertex AI Search, Vector Search, AlloyDB/pgvector), federated vs. ingested architectures, ACL security, semantic caching, and RAG triad evaluation (`RAGAS`).
- [Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADK.html): Open-source code-first framework for enterprise AI agents — `LlmAgent`, `Runner`, `SessionService`, deterministic workflow agents (`SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`), ADK 2.0 graph `Workflow` (`JoinNode`, `Event(route=...)`), multi-agent delegation (`sub_agents`, `AgentTool`, `RemoteA2aAgent`), scoped state & `VertexAiMemoryBankService`, `FunctionTool` & `output_schema`, `McpToolset` & A2A, progressive-disclosure `SkillToolset`, callback/plugin guardrails, HITL resilience (`ReflectAndRetryToolPlugin`), sandboxing (`GkeCodeExecutor`, Agent Identity), trajectory evaluation (`adk eval`, `adk conformance test`), and Agent Runtime / Cloud Run / GKE deployment.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/MCP.html): Open JSON-RPC 2.0 standard connecting AI hosts/clients to external MCP servers via `Resources`, `Prompts`, `Tools`, `Sampling`, and `Roots` over `stdio` and Streamable HTTP/SSE transports.
- [Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/A2A.html): Open multi-agent interoperability standard (Linux Foundation) covering `.well-known/agent-card.json` Agent Cards, capability discovery, Task lifecycle states, Artifacts, streaming (`SendStreamingMessage`), and push notifications.
- [Machine Learning 101 (ML101)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ML101.html): Supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, regression vs. classification, loss functions (`MSE`, `MAE`, cross-entropy), gradient descent, overfitting/regularization (`L1`/`L2`, dropout), confusion matrix metrics (`Precision`, `Recall`, `F1`, `ROC-AUC`), and deep neural networks (`CNN`, `RNN`, `Transformer`).
- [Generative AI 101 (GenAI101)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/GenAI101.html): Foundation model lifecycle, tokenization, self-attention, decoding parameters (`temperature`, `top-k`, `top-p`), adaptation spectrum (prompting, RAG, PEFT/LoRA, RLHF/DPO), hallucination mitigation, and AI safety/governance.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/PromptEngineering.html): Zero-shot/few-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (`CoT`), Self-Consistency, Tree-of-Thoughts (`ToT`), `ReAct`, system prompt architecture, structured JSON outputs, and prompt injection defenses.
- [Google Foundational Models](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/Google.html): Gemini model family (Ultra, Pro, Flash, Nano), multimodal reasoning, Imagen, Chirp, Veo, Codey, Med-PaLM/AlphaFold specialized models, Vertex AI platform, and safety filters.
- [Anthropic Foundational Models](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/Anthropic.html): Core philosophy, the 3-Layer Claude Ecosystem Map (End-User Entry Points including Cowork GUI VM, Builder & Engineering Interfaces, and Cloud Delivery Routes), Constitutional AI (`RLAIF`, 4-tier priority hierarchy & holistic weighting), Mechanistic Interpretability (Sparse Autoencoders, Stream Algorithm, Persona Vectors, Behavioral Vaccination), and Responsible Scaling Policy (`RSP`, `ASL-2`/`ASL-3` CBRN triggers, Constitutional Classifiers, Two-Party Authorization).
- [Claude Platform & API](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ClaudeAPI.html): Building on the Claude API — Messages API request shape, system-prompt altitude, the tool-use loop (`tool_use` / `tool_result`, `tool_use_id`, `is_error`, `tool_choice`), agent scaling & programmatic tool calling (`CodeMode` in V8 isolates), `stop_reason` handling (including `refusal`, `max_tokens`, `model_context_window_exceeded`), streaming events, structured outputs, adaptive thinking with `effort`, 4 context strategies (`Write / Select / Compress / Isolate`), context rot taxonomy (`poisoning / confusion / clash`), multi-agent context contracts, compaction and prompt caching, Message Batches, retriable vs. terminal errors, evals and cost levers, deployment platforms (Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry), data residency, model-ID pinning, and security for API apps.
- [Claude Code & Agent SDK](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ClaudeCode.html): Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK — execution surfaces (worktrees, cloud web/mobile, `/teleport`), Deep Agent 4-pillar architecture, permission modes and allow/ask/deny rules, settings and `CLAUDE.md` memory precedence, context rot & `/clear` vs `/compact`, `/output-style` & `/statusline`, Spec-Driven Development (`SPEC.md` + `TodoWrite`), hooks (`PreToolUse`, exit-code semantics), subagents & wave scaling, skills (`SKILL.md`, 3-level progressive disclosure), plugins and marketplaces, MCP configuration (`.mcp.json` scopes, env expansion), headless CI (`claude -p --bare`, `/install-github-app`, `/rewind` checkpointing), team rollout with managed settings, Agent SDK `settingSources`, and Managed Agents.
- [Agentic Design Patterns (ADP)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADP.html): Vendor-neutral architectural blueprint for agentic systems — 4-Decision Architectural Order, 3-Bucket Work Decomposition (Deterministic Code vs. Probabilistic LLM vs. Human Review), 5-Factor Work-Shape Matrix (Single Call vs. Composable Workflow vs. Autonomous Agent), the 5 Canonical Workflows (Prompt Chaining, Routing, Parallelization Sectioning & Voting, Orchestrator-Workers, Evaluator-Optimizer with Cold-Context Critic), Autonomous Agent Primitives (ReAct, ACI 6-Rule Tool Design, 3-Tier Error Recovery), 4-Tier CoALA Memory & Context Budget Engineering, and Multi-Agent Topologies with typed `HandoffContract` isolation.
- [AI Evals, Observability & FinOps](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIEvalsAndOps.html): Production evaluation, telemetry, resilience, and token economics — 3-Tier Grading Hierarchy (Deterministic Code → Calibrated LLM-as-Judge → Human Domain Calibration), judge bias mitigation & Cohen's kappa calibration, `pass@k` vs. `pass^k` compound reliability math, the 4-Level Agent Test Pyramid & integration seam failures, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing & Input vs. Model Drift, 4-Layer Resilience Stack (backoff + jitter, circuit breakers, eval-validated fallbacks, escalation), Offline Replay / Shadow Mode vs. 4-Element A/B Testing, heavy-tail `p95`/`p99` sizing, ~15× multi-agent token multiplier, 4-Step Enterprise ROI math (including human-review tax), and 3-Tier Feasibility Verdicts.
- [AI Guardrails, Safety & Enterprise Governance](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIGovernance.html): Defense-in-depth safety, oversight, fairness, privacy, and governance lifecycle — Trained Alignment vs. Application Guardrails, 4-Tier Trust Hierarchy & breaking the Prompt Injection Lethal Trifecta, the 3×2 Guardrail Matrix (Pre-Inference Input, In-Loop Tool Authorization, Post-Inference Output × Deterministic / Model-Based, fail-closed design), Stakes-Based HITL Routing (Reversibility × Blast Radius, defeating Automation Bias & Consent Fatigue), the 4D AI Fluency & Verification Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence), 4 Pipeline Fairness Injection Points & Subgroup Disaggregation, 3 Transparency Audiences, Zero Data Retention (ZDR) vs. No-Training & per-feature HIPAA BAA scoping, and Enterprise Governance (4 Discovery Scoping Categories, 4-Part Reversal-Cost Tradeoffs, ADRs with Rejected Alternatives, Evidenced Control Register).
- [Vibe Coding & Swarm Prototyping](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/vibecoding.html): Conversational AI-assisted software development (Vibe Coding) vs. parallel multi-agent exploration (Swarm Prototyping), risk profiles, verification gates, and production handoff.
- [Instruction-Driven Development (IDD / SDD)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/idd.html): Specification-Driven Development workflow where living markdown specs (`SPEC.md`), architecture rules, and automated acceptance verification drive deterministic AI code generation.

## Interactive Practice Quizzes

- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=rag): 22 scenario-based multiple-choice questions with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Agent Development Kit (ADK) Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=adk): 25 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 16 ADK sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Claude Platform & API Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=claude-api): 32 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 14 Claude API sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Claude Code & Agent SDK Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=claude-code): 32 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 13 Claude Code sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Agentic Design Patterns (ADP) Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=adp): 30 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 7 ADP sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [AI Evals, Observability & FinOps Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=ai-evals-ops): 30 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 8 AI Evals & FinOps sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [AI Guardrails, Safety & Governance Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=ai-governance): 30 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 8 AI Governance sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
